notes.title: XIIZEAL V1.05 : Fix for replay scores overwriting local scores
notes.notes:
The latest version for XIIZEAL is out and it fixes the following things:
[list]
    [*]Fix for replay scores downloaded from the leaderboard etc that would overwrite player's local score.
    [*]Fix to prevent monitor powering off while game is active.
    [*]Enabled window to be resized by dragging the edge of it.
    [*]Added boot_log.txt to the folder containing the game's executable to save log data.
    [*]Added the ability to change the sensitivity of the left stick on Direct Input controllers by editing win_state.ini (details below).
    [*]Fixed leaderboard functionality whereby pressing X to show player position would not function properly.
[/list]

[b]Settings File win_state.ini[/b]
By editing this file, located with the game executable, you can change game settings.
If the file is not saved or cannot be loaded, settings are reverted to default.
File format must be Unicode + BOM.
Left stick sensitivity for USB controllers can be adjusted as follows: controller_threshold	0.5f	; [0.0f - 1.0f]

Thanks for playing XIIZEAL and keep on waggling!

notes.title: Triangle Service Score Attack Competitions!
notes.notes:
To celebrate the Steam Summer Sale... http://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=Degica
...we have two awesome scoring competitions running throughout the sale! 

One in DELTAZEAL...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/379520/
...and the other in XIIZEAL!...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/364250/
The competitions are running from the moment the Summer Sale starts (6/23) to the moment it ends (7/4). In both competitions, the rules are the same: make sure you are one of the top 3 scores recorded between the competition dates in Stage 1 Score Attack, Normal difficult, and you win the prize.

You must be set to Normal difficulty with “Save Replays” set to “On” in the game’s settings. Replays must be submitted to be counted. Stage 1 Score Attack can easily be unlocked by completing Stage 1 in Arcade Mode.

The prize for the DELTAZEAL competition: a prerelease copy of Triangle Service’s EXZEAL

The prize for the XIIZEAL competitions: a prerelease copy of Triangle Service’s TRIZEAL Remix.

So fire up your boosters, and zealously strive for the perfect score!

notes.title: XIIZEAL V1.04 Leaderboard Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]XIIZEAL V1.04 Patch Details - 07/07/2015[/b]

This patch update fixes minor bugs in the leaderboards.

[list][*]Fixed an error where replay icons weren't shown past rank 20 on the leaderboards.
[*]XIIZEAL now displays a "Connecting now" message while retrieving leaderboard data.
[*]Fixed an error that would show an empty leaderboard instead of the "No Entry" notification.[/list]

リーダーボードのマイナー修正 

[list][*]リーダーボード閲覧時20位より大きい順位にリプレイがアタッチされているのにその情報が表示されていなかったのを修正。
[*]リーダーボード閲覧時ページ送りの際"CONNECTING NOW..."と表示するよう修正。
[*]リーダーボード閲覧時エントリーの無いリーダーボードが表示されていたのを修正。[/list]

notes.title: XIIZEAL V1.03 : Score & replay on all difficulty + Replay sharing! / 全難易度のスコアとリプレイとリプレイのシェア
notes.notes:
XIIZEAL is now updated to version 1.03, adding expanded leaderboard and replay functions!

[b]XIIZEAL V1.03 Patch Details:[/b]

◆[Fix] Replay Error : Fixed an error that caused replays to display incorrectly when multiple shot buttons were used.
◆[New] Notification on continue : The game now displays a notification that your game will be ineligible for saved replays and score submission if you continue. 
◆[New] Expanded Leaderboards to record submitted scores on all difficulty settings. 
◆[New] Replays can now be saved on any difficulty setting. 
◆[New] Replays can now be uploaded to the leaderboards and downloaded by other players!

[b]v1.03の追加機能・修正点のまとめ[/b]

◆「修正」　 リプレイ問題：ショットボタンが複数設定されている場合、リプレイが不正になる問題を修正
◆「新規」　コンティニュー時の警告：　最初にコンティニューする時、スコアの登録とリプレイの保存ができなくなる警告を表示。
◆「新規」　リーダーボード拡張：全難易度のスコアが登録されるように変更
◆「新規」　リプレイ保存の拡張：全難易度でリプレイがセーブされるように変更
◆「新規」　リーダボードスコアのリプレイを共有：リーダーボードスコアにリプレイが追加され、共有・閲覧できるようになります

notes.title: Zap Zap: Vintage Shmup XIIZeal On PC
notes.notes:
How do you like your shoot ‘em ups: vertically scrolling and difficult to get hold of? If so, you might dig XIIZeal [official site], which has come to PC years after various versions bounced around arcades and consoles in Japan. Please pardon my ignorance of shmup history, but I believe it’s an updated version of 2002’s XIIStag by Triangle Service. As I understand it, your best chance to play Zeal was to import an Xbox 360 shmup compilation for 30. Well, now it’s on Steam for 8.99.

… [visit site to read more]
